name: codex-google-copy
description: A local Chrome automation bridge for Codex using a Chrome extension, WebSocket server, and Python SDK.

interface.shortDescription: Control Chrome from Codex through a local WebSocket bridge.
interface.longDescription: Codex Google Copy provides instructions for using the bundled Chrome extension, local WebSocket bridge, and Python SDK to navigate, inspect, click, type, and evaluate pages in a local Chrome session.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the NodeX Browser Agent bridge in this repository to control my local Chrome browser safely.
